title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 20: Tartan takes Ashdod, Isaiah walks naked and barefoot as a sign against Egypt and Ethiopia.

questions.explanation: Verse 1 says Tartan came to Ashdod when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him.

questions.text: What did Tartan do at Ashdod?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he fought against Ashdod and took it.

answers.text: He fought against it and took it
He besieged it for three years without success
He made a covenant with it

questions.text: Isaiah is the son of which man?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that at that time Yahweh spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz.

questions.text: What was Isaiah told to loosen from off his waist?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 records Yahweh's command: "Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet."

questions.text: How did Isaiah walk after obeying the command?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

questions.text: For how many years did Isaiah walk naked and barefoot?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says Isaiah walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder.

questions.text: Concerning which two lands was Isaiah's sign given?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says it was a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia.

questions.text: Who will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the king of Assyria will lead them away, young and old, naked and barefoot, to the shame of Egypt.

questions.text: Why will the people be dismayed and confounded?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they will be dismayed and confounded because of Ethiopia their expectation and of Egypt their glory.

answers.text: Because of the famine in their land
Because their gods were carried away

questions.text: What will the inhabitants of the coast land ask in that day?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says they will say, "Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help... And we, how will we escape?"
